entry.name: Gryt Server
entry.description: Gryt is an open source voice, video and text chat platform. Connect with the Gryt desktop app or the hosted web client at https://app.gryt.chat. The first user to join becomes the owner; afterwards the server is invite-only. Requirements: - amd64 only (the Gryt Linux bundle is x64 only) - needs two extra allocations: one for the SFU websocket (set SFU_PORT to its port), one for voice media (set ICE_UDP_MUX_PORT to its port) - set SFU_PUBLIC_HOST to <public-ip>:<SFU_PORT> so voice works over the internet

The first user to join becomes the owner; afterwards the server is invite-only. Requirements: - amd64 only (the Gryt Linux bundle is x64 only) - needs two extra allocations: one for the SFU websocket (set SFU_PORT to its port), one for voice media (set ICE_UDP_MUX_PORT to its port) - set SFU_PUBLIC_HOST to <public-ip>:<SFU_PORT> so voice works over the internet
egg.startup: if [ -z "$JWT_SECRET" ]; then [ -f .jwt_secret ] || head -c 48 /dev/urandom | base64 > .jwt_secret; export JWT_SECRET="$(cat .jwt_secret)"; fi; ./gryt_sfu & if [ "$IMAGE_WORKER_ENABLED" != "false" ]; then node --env-file=config.env image-worker/dist/index.js & fi; exec node --env-file=config.env server/dist/index.js

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Gryt Server (self-hosted Linux bundle) installation script

set -e

cd /mnt/server

## The Gryt Linux bundle is x86_64 only
if [ "$(uname -m)" != "x86_64" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: This egg requires an x86_64 (amd64) node, this one is $(uname -m)."
    echo "Gryt only publishes x64 self-hosted bundles (the gryt_sfu binary cannot run here)."
    exit 1
fi

## Resolve the release to install
if [ -z "${GRYT_VERSION}" ] || [ "${GRYT_VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
    echo "Resolving latest Gryt release..."
    RELEASE_JSON=$(curl -sSL https://api.github.com/repos/Gryt-chat/server/releases/latest)
    RESOLVED_VERSION=$(echo "${RELEASE_JSON}" | jq -r '.tag_name | ltrimstr("v")')
    DOWNLOAD_URL=$(echo "${RELEASE_JSON}" | jq -r '.assets[] | select(.name | test("^gryt-server-linux-x64-v[0-9].*\\.zip$")) | .browser_download_url')
else
    RESOLVED_VERSION="${GRYT_VERSION#v}"
    DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/Gryt-chat/server/releases/download/v${RESOLVED_VERSION}/gryt-server-linux-x64-v${RESOLVED_VERSION}.zip"
fi

if [ -z "${RESOLVED_VERSION}" ] || [ "${RESOLVED_VERSION}" = "null" ] || [ -z "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ] || [ "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" = "null" ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Could not resolve a Gryt release for version '${GRYT_VERSION}'."
    exit 1
fi

echo "Installing Gryt Server v${RESOLVED_VERSION} (linux-x64 bundle)"

## Download and extract the bundle
echo "Downloading ${DOWNLOAD_URL} ..."
curl -sSL --fail -o /mnt/server/gryt.zip "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

unzip -q -o /mnt/server/gryt.zip -d /mnt/server
cp -a /mnt/server/gryt-server-linux-x64/. /mnt/server/
rm -rf /mnt/server/gryt-server-linux-x64 /mnt/server/gryt.zip

## Unused bundle wrappers (the egg starts node/gryt_sfu directly)
rm -f /mnt/server/start.bat /mnt/server/gryt_server.bat /mnt/server/gryt_image_worker.bat \
      /mnt/server/gryt_server.sh /mnt/server/gryt_image_worker.sh

if [ ! -f /mnt/server/server/dist/index.js ] || [ ! -f /mnt/server/gryt_sfu ]; then
    echo "ERROR: Bundle seems incomplete (server/dist/index.js or gryt_sfu missing)."
    exit 1
fi

chmod +x /mnt/server/gryt_sfu
mkdir -p /mnt/server/data

echo "Installation of Gryt Server v${RESOLVED_VERSION} complete."
exit 0

variables.name: Gryt Version
variables.description: The Gryt Server version to install (e.g. 1.6.5 or latest). Reinstall the server to apply a change.

variables.name: JWT Secret
variables.description: Secret for session tokens. Leave empty to auto-generate a persistent one on first start.

variables.name: SFU Port
variables.description: TCP port of the voice SFU websocket. Must match an extra port allocation.

variables.name: SFU Public Host
variables.description: Public address of the SFU given to clients, e.g. 203.0.113.10:5005 or sfu.example.com:5005 (wss://... behind a TLS proxy only!). Required for voice over the internet.

variables.name: Voice Media Port (UDP)
variables.description: The one UDP port all WebRTC media flows over (ICE_UDP_MUX_PORT). Must match an extra UDP port allocation.

variables.name: ICE Advertise IP
variables.description: Public IP(s) advertised in ICE candidates, comma-separated (e.g. 203.0.113.10, 203.0.113.11). Leave empty if STUN auto-discovery works. Set your public IP if the server runs behind NAT or voice does not work.

variables.name: Max Voice Peers
variables.description: How many peers may be connected to the SFU at once.

variables.name: STUN Servers
variables.description: Comma-separated STUN URIs for NAT traversal.

variables.name: CORS Origins
variables.description: Allowed origins, comma-separated. Keep http://127.0.0.1:15738 (desktop app) and https://app.gryt.chat (hosted web client).

variables.name: Identity Tiers
variables.description: Comma-separated identity types the server accepts: account (Gryt account) and/or local (no account).

variables.name: External Host
variables.description: URL clients use to reach this server, e.g. http://203.0.113.10:5000

variables.name: Image Worker
variables.description: Run the image worker (thumbnails, recompression, voice tile colors). true or false.

variables.name: Disable STUN
variables.description: Stop the SFU from discovering its public IP via STUN. Only use with a direct, port-preserving path to the internet and set ICE_ADVERTISE_IP instead. true or false.

entry.name: LanguageTool
entry.description:
This egg installs a LanguageTool server

LanguageTool is an Open Source proofreading software for English, French, German, Polish, Russian, and more than 20 other languages. It finds many errors that a simple spell checker cannot find.

View https://languagetool.org for more information.

egg.name: LanguageTool
egg.author: thomasruhl@live.de
egg.description:
This egg installs a LanguageTool server

LanguageTool is an Open Source proofreading software for English, French, German, Polish, Russian, and more than 20 other languages. It finds many errors that a simple spell checker cannot find.

View https://languagetool.org for more information.

installation.script:
#!/bin/ash
apk add --no-cache unzip # to make shure the unzipper is working properly
mkdir -p /mnt/server
mkdir -p /mnt/server/models
touch config.properties

# if TRAIN_MODELS has content install them
if [ -n TRAIN_MODELS ]; then

    content=$(curl -L https://languagetool.org/download/ngram-data/)

    links=$(echo "$content" | grep -o '<a href="[^"]*\.zip">' | sed 's/<a href="//' | sed 's/">//')
    echo $links

    cd /mnt/server/models
    for model in $TRAIN_MODELS; do
        echo "$model"
        for link in $links; do
            # echo "    $link"
            if [[ $link == *"-$model-"* ]]; then
                fullLink="https://languagetool.org/download/ngram-data/$link"
                echo "Downloading $fullLink"
                echo "this could take some while"
                curl $fullLink --output $model.zip
                echo "unziping $model.zip"
                unzip $model.zip
                rm $model.zip
            fi
        done
    done
fi

# main languagetool install
cd /mnt/server

echo "downloading languagetool"
curl https://languagetool.org/download/LanguageTool-stable.zip --output download.zip
echo unziping
unzip download.zip
echo moving files

cp -r LanguageTool-*/* .

rm -rf LanguageTool-*
rm download.zip -rf

echo Finished install

variables.name: Include traindata
variables.description:
This uses many gigabytes of disk space. 

Separate each value with spaces. For example, "de en". 

View all available models at https://languagetool.org/download/ngram-data/

entry.description:
A standalone audio sending node based on Lavaplayer and Koe. Allows for sending audio without it ever reaching any of your shards.
Description taken from https://github.com/lavalink-devs/Lavalink

egg.name: Lavalink
egg.author: damuffin36@gmail.com
egg.description:
A standalone audio sending node based on Lavaplayer and Koe. Allows for sending audio without it ever reaching any of your shards.
Description taken from https://github.com/lavalink-devs/Lavalink

installation.script:
## this is a simple script to use the github API for release versions.
## this requires the egg has a variable for GITHUB_PACKAGE, VERSION and MATCH (match is to match the filename in some way)
## this supports using oauth/personal access tokens via GITHUB_USER and GITHUB_OAUTH_TOKEN (both are required.)
## if you are getting hit with GitHub API limit issues then you need to have the user and token set.
apt update
apt install -y curl jq git

cd /mnt/server

if [ -z "${GITHUB_USER}" ] && [ -z "${GITHUB_OAUTH_TOKEN}" ] ; then
    echo -e "using anon api call"
else
    echo -e "user and oauth token set"
    alias curl='curl -u ${GITHUB_USER}:${GITHUB_OAUTH_TOKEN} '
fi

## get release info and download links
LATEST_JSON=$(curl --silent "https://api.github.com/repos/${GITHUB_PACKAGE}/releases/latest")
RELEASES=$(curl --silent "https://api.github.com/repos/${GITHUB_PACKAGE}/releases")

if [ -z "${VERSION}" ] || [ "${VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    DOWNLOAD_URL=$(echo ${LATEST_JSON} | jq .assets | jq -r .[].browser_download_url | grep -i ${MATCH})
else
    VERSION_CHECK=$(echo ${RELEASES} | jq -r --arg VERSION "${VERSION}" '.[] | select(.tag_name==$VERSION) | .tag_name')
    if [ "${VERSION}" == "${VERSION_CHECK}" ]; then
        DOWNLOAD_URL=$(echo ${RELEASES} | jq -r --arg VERSION "${VERSION}" '.[] | select(.tag_name==$VERSION) | .assets[].browser_download_url' | grep -i ${MATCH})
    else
        echo -e "defaulting to latest release"
        DOWNLOAD_URL=$(echo ${LATEST_JSON} | jq .assets | jq -r .[].browser_download_url)
    fi
fi
if [ ! -z "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ]; then 
    if curl --output /dev/null --silent --head --fail ${DOWNLOAD_URL}; then
        echo -e "link is valid. setting download link to ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
        DOWNLOAD_LINK=${DOWNLOAD_URL}
    else        
        echo -e "link is invalid closing out"
        exit 2
    fi
fi

curl -L -o Lavalink.jar ${DOWNLOAD_URL}
curl -L -o application.yml https://raw.githubusercontent.com/freyacodes/Lavalink/master/LavalinkServer/application.yml.example

echo "-------------------------------------------------------"
echo "Installation completed"
echo "-------------------------------------------------------"
